features: 【⌨️ Retro Round Keycaps for Comfortable Typing】 Experience a unique blend of vintage aesthetics and modern functionality with stylish round keycaps designed for comfortable, responsive, and accurate typing. Ideal for work, study, home offices, and everyday productivity.

【📶 Stable 2.4GHz Wireless Connectivity】 Enjoy reliable cable-free performance through advanced 2.4GHz wireless technology using a shared USB receiver. Provides stable transmission with minimal lag for seamless typing and navigation across supported devices.

【🖱️ Precision 1200 DPI Optical Mouse】 The included wireless mouse features up to 1200 DPI tracking resolution and 4 responsive buttons, delivering smooth cursor movement and precise control for browsing, office work, learning, and entertainment.

【⚡ Plug & Play with Intelligent Power Saving】 Simply connect the USB receiver and start using the combo instantly without installing drivers. Smart power-saving technology helps extend battery life while automatic sleep mode conserves energy during inactivity.

【💻 Wide Compatibility for Work & Entertainment】 Compatible with Windows XP, 7, 8, and 10 systems and supports computers, laptops, and compatible TVs. The compact wireless design creates a clean, clutter-free workspace for home, office, and study environments.
